Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will testify before the U.S. Senate Banking Committee on Dec. 3, as congressional investigations continue into his relationship scandal and potential breaches of national security, despite President Donald Trump's support and insistence that he deserved his job back. Just hours after Huang was [reinstated to run Nvidia](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/11/23/jensen-huang-returns-as-nvidia-ceo-as-shares-jump-27), the Senate committee [announced a date had been set](https://www.banking.senate.gov/hearings/protecting-americas-ai-advantage-oversight-of-us-export-controls)to hear directly from the CEO in a hearing entitled, "Protecting America’s AI Advantage: Oversight of U.S. Export Controls."
